micro_markets.name: Worli
micro_markets.notes: Square Yards property-rates page, Sep 2026: average asking price Rs 66,300/sq ft and average rent Rs 268/sq ft a month, which gives a gross yield of 4.85%. Square Yards' Worli overview page (https://www.squareyards.com/worli-in-mumbai-overview-911) also gives 3.89% in its text without stating a date or method. These are listing-based (asking) figures.

micro_markets.name: Altamount Road
micro_markets.notes: No yield is published for Altamount Road itself. The 4.39% figure is for the surrounding Cumballa Hill locality: Square Yards, Sep 2026, average asking price Rs 65,900/sq ft and rent Rs 241/sq ft a month. The same page lists Altamount Road separately at an asking price of Rs 1,35,400/sq ft and a rent of Rs 200/sq ft a month. Computed: that implies a gross yield of only about 1.8% for Altamount Road listings, so the locality figure likely overstates yields on this street.
